delivered_readme:
# Resource reads

Content, availability and counts use the same eligibility policy.

An entry is eligible only while it is active and `now < expiresAt`. At or after
`expiresAt`, content reads return `null`, availability is false, and counts
exclude the entry.

Run `npm test` to execute the Jest suite. Native assertions also exist.

The legacy label is documented as `current`; it is independent of resource eligibility.

Documentation navigation refers to [deployment instructions](docs/deployment.md).
